serviceArea.title: Service area: mainland China only (excluding Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan)
serviceArea.body: Professional wheel building is currently available only for addresses within mainland China. Components must be sent from a mainland China address to the confirmed workshop address, and finished wheels can only be returned to a mainland China address. Overseas, Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and other cross-border shipments are not supported. Confirm the address, accepted parts, and shipping cost in chat before sending anything.

professional.title: Professional Wheel Building Service
professional.body: We provide professional wheel building for customers who need compatible hubs, rims, and spokes built at the workshop. Our technicians check the incoming parts, then complete the build, truing, and basic inspection.
professional.feeBody: USD 30 per set for standard wheel building; return shipping, replacement parts, special work, and non-standard rework are not included. The confirmed quote is final.
professional.bestForBody: Customers who can provide complete specifications and a packing list while sending compatible hubs, rims, spokes, and related parts for a professional build.
professional.button: Get Wheel Building Quote via Chat

shipping.title: Shipping
shipping.body: Confirm the service area, addresses, compatibility, and shipping cost, then send the parts to the confirmed address with a packing list.

confirmation.title: Confirmation
confirmation.body: We check the model, quantity, condition, and damage. If anything is missing or incompatible, we contact you before starting the build.

assembly.title: Assembly & testing
assembly.body: We build and true the wheels to the confirmed spoke length and lacing pattern, then perform spoke-tension and basic safety checks. Special requests must be confirmed in advance.

delivery.title: Delivery
delivery.body: Finished wheels are returned only to the confirmed mainland China address, or prepared for an agreed pickup. Return shipping and insurance follow the confirmed quote.

scope.title: Scope & Notes
scope.acceptedBody: Compatible rims, hubs, spokes, nipples, and related small parts. Confirm the hole count, axle standard, brake mount, freehub standard, and rim system before arranging shipment.
scope.spareSpokesBody: If the matching spoke is difficult to source during travel or racing, add spare spokes to the quote. Confirm quantity by front/rear wheel, drive/non-drive side, and length; the exact model, stock, and price follow the current quote.
items: Components must be new or in good condition. Parts with cracks, deformation, impact damage, or severe wear may be refused.
Before shipping, provide the model, hole count, dimensions, freehub/brake interface, and a detailed packing list.
Typical turnaround is 3-7 business days after every part arrives and compatibility is confirmed; missing parts, rework, or special requests can extend it.
The customer covers round-trip shipping, packing, insurance, and any applicable charges; this service is limited to mainland China.

ownBuild.title: Building Your Own Wheels?
ownBuild.body: If you prefer to assemble yourself using these parts, we support you. Access our technical guides and customization options below.

mullet.title: Mullet Wheelsets (Mixed Size)
mullet.body: A practical setup for modern MTB builds: 29 inch front + 27.5 inch rear or 27.5 inch front + 26 inch rear. Use this when rollover, grip, and rear-end agility matter more than a matched wheel diameter.
mullet.frontBody: Prioritizes rollover capability, steering grip, and high-speed stability.
mullet.rearBody: Improves acceleration, bike handling, and rear-frame clearance.

singleWheel.title: Single Wheel Customization
singleWheel.body: Use this path when you only need a front or rear replacement, want to reuse a compatible hub, or need one wheel matched to an existing build.
singleWheel.beforeBody: Confirm axle standard, brake mount, spoke count, freehub body, rim depth, and tire clearance so the replacement wheel works with the current bike.

mixedRim.title: Mixed Rim Profiles
mixedRim.body: Example riding scenarios where mixed rim profiles, with different front and rear specifications, provide a tactical advantage. This approach balances aerodynamics, handling, and durability.

differentModels.title: Different models
differentModels.body: Using completely different rim models, such as a lightweight front and heavy-duty rear, is common in custom builds to balance specific performance needs.

differentHeights.title: Different heights
differentHeights.body: For example, a 50mm front for handling plus a 60mm rear for aerodynamics and stiffness. This is a common mixed setup for crosswind stability and speed.

climbing.title: Climbing
climbing.body: Front for handling and weight, rear for stiffness.

aero.title: Aerodynamics
aero.body: Front balances crosswinds, rear maximizes speed.

training.title: Training / Durability
training.sizes: Front: mid alloy/carbon. Rear: high/wide profile.
training.body: Rear bears load, front preserves comfort.

versatile.title: Mixed / Versatile
versatile.body: A balanced choice for racing and training.
